# Ishan Bose

CMO, KreditBee | TEDx Speaker | HT Mint Youth Marketer of the Year | Building India’s Largest Fintech Lending Platform for Professionals

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (IN)

500 connections • 17,910 followers

## About

Ishan is a core founding team member of KreditBee (India's Largest FinTech Lending Platform for Personal Loans). He is currently leading Business for New User Acquisition, Marketing, Sales (Field, Inside), Partnerships & Alliances (lending aggregators, lead-generation DSA partners, and Corporates & HRMS platforms) and PR for KreditBee. He is directly accountable for new user acquisition business of KreditBee, currently worth over ₹400 Crores a month. He has also handled B2B Sales, Collections, and Customer Support at various stages in his current organization. Personal interests include traveling (has explored 100+ cities across 27 countries), playing Chess (University-level Gold medalist), following sports (Cricket, Football, Tennis & F1) & public speaking (50+ engagements till date). Key Areas of Specialization (Broad) - 1. Business Leadership (User Acquisition, Retention) 2. Performance Marketing 3. Brand Marketing 4. Product Marketing 5. Partnerships & Strategic Alliances 6. SEO, ASO 7. Sales Management (Field, Telephonic) Consulting Projects - 1. BCG 2. Deloitte 3. McKinsey 4. NIUM Individual Awards - 1. Youth Marketer of the Year by Mint Marketing Awards (HT), 2022 2.
